narrative.summary: The Ibero-American community's recorded AI text is the Madrid Declaration of the Ibero-American Ministerial Meeting on Digital Transformation and Artificial Intelligence, adopted on 3 November 2026 ahead of the XXX Ibero-American Summit. Ministers commit to people-centred, safe and trustworthy AI with human oversight in decisions with significant effects on people, approve an Ibero-American AI Alliance for adoption by the Summit, and adopt non-binding reference frameworks on data protection and on digital identification and interoperability. Argentina and Paraguay dissociated themselves from the declaration.
lead_institutions: Ibero-American Ministerial Meeting on Digital Transformation and Artificial Intelligence
narrative.review_notes: The Ibero-American General Secretariat site and the site of Spain's Ministry for Digital Transformation, host of the 2026 ministerial meeting, were searched in a single pass. The declaration is published by the host government; no copy on the Secretariat's site was found. Pending: the decision of the XXX Ibero-American Summit on the AI Alliance.

instruments.current_status: Adopted in Madrid on 3 November 2026, in preparation for the XXX Ibero-American Summit; Argentina and Paraguay dissociated themselves from the declaration. The AI Alliance goes to the Summit for approval, with voluntary accession afterwards. Published on the official site of the host government (Spain, Ministry for Digital Transformation); no copy on the SEGIB site was found.
instruments.scope: Ibero-American countries that did not dissociate from the declaration.
instruments.summary: Ministerial declaration of Ibero-American countries committing to people-centred, safe and trustworthy AI with data protection, cybersecurity, transparency, proportionate traceability and human oversight where AI is used in decisions with significant effects on people, and to age-appropriate, bias-free digital environments. It approves an Ibero-American AI Alliance (a federated data and interoperability space, AI models in Spanish, Portuguese and other languages, and high-performance computing cooperation) for adoption by the XXX Ibero-American Summit, and adopts non-binding Ibero-American reference frameworks on data protection and on digital identification and interoperability in digital government services.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Ministerial commitments on AI across the Ibero-American community, including a proposed Ibero-American AI Alliance.
